# UI static review: PASS

This verdict covers developer CLI/help-source wording and evidence presentation for the uncommitted working-tree content in `/workspace/android-studio-reference-membership`, based on `c1ce5ca16a26fd59984b50500ead45fbafafa5c8`. It does not validate a running IDE, generated help, executed CLI output, or Android Studio visual fidelity.

No blocking or nonblocking findings were identified in this scope.

- **UI-1 — PASS:** Command name and help-source wording describe bounded pinned source evidence. Required source-root, selection and output paths are explicit; check mode is separate and documented. Help and CLI were inspected in source, not executed.
- **UI-2 — PASS:** Pretty-printed deterministic JSON preserves separate files, BUILD loads, module facts, attributes, relationships and runner observations. Exact source identities, hashes and byte spans keep output auditable.
- **UI-3 — PASS:** Evidence expressly uses null effective_runtime_cases, null module compiled_membership/runtime_cases, unresolved applicability, false global_census_complete and zero new_original_behavior_credit. Source relationship provenance and runtime_verified=false prevent promotion of declarations into actual test membership.
- **UI-4 — PASS:** Unsupported macro/computed/glob/conditional/shadowed inputs retain named unresolved evidence; lexical/budget and unsafe/pin-boundary failures report explicit errors. Documentation limits literal_coverage_complete to supported BUILD syntax and separates it from runtime completeness.
- **UI-5 — PASS:** Create-new publication refuses replacement. Check mode compares complete encoded bytes and never writes. Documentation supplies complete create/check commands and clarifies retained archive-member provenance versus compressed archive reverification.
- **UI-6 — PASS:** All 16 retained original files match selected complete lengths and SHA-256 hashes. AOSP and JetBrains source identities stay separate, attribution and Apache license references are retained, and canonical manifest/95-row ledger and existing discovery modules are byte-identical to base.
- **UI-7 — PASS:** The changed/untracked paths contain tooling, complete discovery fixtures and tooling documentation only. No product view/layout/theme/keymap changes are present. This review supplies no Android Studio visual fidelity credit.

Normal tests, actual CLI flows, repository checks, full-app/current-workspace CI, and the final lead gate remain pending. No product UI credit or new original behavioral test credit is awarded. Runtime membership remains unresolved and the global census remains incomplete.

The companion JSON records exact reviewed file hashes and all 16 original-input checks. This reviewer ran read-only file/Git inspections and wrote these external reports only; no Cargo, compiler, SDK, app, cache, source, or Git mutation occurred. The source read hold is released.
